verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local, on-device inference engine for running MoE models. It has no hosted production environment or production data store, so a separate sandbox-versus-production environment is not a meaningful axis for this kind of product. The unit tests that run without real weights and the read-only base model are developer and model-integrity features, not a sandbox environment, and they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
